name: CloudBank
lede: Your money, self-hosted. A free personal finance manager — a from-scratch web port of HomeBank, built for the browser and the cloud.
about: A free, open-source, self-hosted personal finance manager — a web port of HomeBank. Shipping at {version}.
description: CloudBank is a free, open-source, self-hosted personal finance manager — a production-ready web port of HomeBank. Accounts, a powerful register, scheduled transactions, budgets, rich reports, automatic bank sync, bank mails, notifications, an optional AI with your own key and a customizable dashboard.
summary: A free, open-source, self-hosted web port of HomeBank — now production-ready, with automatic bank sync and a fully customizable dashboard.
